# sreagent_slis (Data Source)

Every sli row, read-only. A service level indicator. Approving one stays a human decision in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_slis" "all" {}

output "slis_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_slis.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `data_source_id` (String) The data source the query runs on.
- `description` (String) What the indicator measures.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `name` (String) Shown on the SLO pages.
- `query` (String) The query against the data source.
- `service` (String) The service measured.
- `sli_type` (String) latency, availability and so on. Changing it replaces the SLI.
- `status` (String) draft, approved or archived; changed in the app.
